case_title: SUSANTA DAS & ORS. v. STATE OF ORISSA
aggravating_circumstances: Common object, use of deadly weapons, presence of all accused at the scene
trial_court_outcome: Acquitted of some accused, convicted of accused-Ashok Das alias Gopal Das for murder and causing grievous hurt
high_court_outcome: Convicted all accused under Sections 302, 148, 326, 307 r/w 149
neutral_facts: The accused, five in number, were armed with deadly weapons and obstructed a motorcycle carrying three individuals. When the individuals attempted to escape, the accused chased them and assaulted them with the weapons. One of the individuals died as a result of the assault, and the other two sustained injuries. The prosecution presented evidence from eyewitnesses, medical reports, and recovered weapons to establish the involvement of all five accused in the incident. The trial court acquitted some accused but convicted one for murder and causing grievous hurt. The High Court overturned the acquittals and convicted all accused under the relevant sections of the IPC.
